entities.name: A5WE50 Aspartate ligase
observations: Exact sequence-hash match to the 601-residue query; reviewed Swiss-Prot entry from Psychrobacter sp. PRwf-1.
Annotated as cytoplasmic aspartate--tRNA(Asp/Asn) ligase, EC 6.1.1.23.
Catalyzes ATP-dependent activation of L-aspartate to Asp-AMP followed by transfer of aspartate to tRNA(Asp/Asn).
GO terms include aspartate-tRNA ligase activity, aspartate-tRNA(Asn) ligase activity, ATP binding, nucleic-acid binding, and aspartyl-tRNA aminoacylation.
Sequence analysis identifies tRNA_anti-codon domain PF01336 at residues 19-103, tRNA-synt_2 domain PF00152 at residues 121-566, and GAD domain PF02938 at residues 311-416.

entities.name: Aspartyl-tRNA aminoacylation
observations: Overall reaction: tRNA(Asp/Asn) + L-aspartate + ATP → L-aspartyl-tRNA(Asp/Asn) + AMP + diphosphate.
The reaction proceeds through an enzyme-bound aspartyl-AMP intermediate.

entities.name: Aspartyl-tRNA synthetase domains
observations: The query contains a tRNA anticodon-recognition domain (PF01336, residues 19-103) and the class-II aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase catalytic domain (PF00152, residues 121-566).

A GAD-associated region (PF02938, residues 311-416) was detected within the catalytic portion; its presence supports the observed domain architecture but does not independently define a separate glutamate decarboxylase function.
